pasayha.cp: abs. of pasahati. forcibly; having used force.

H: pasayha：pasahati 的 ger．無理不講理，強迫強制．
C: pasayha：[abs．of pasahati] forcibly； having used force．
U: PASAYHA：[abs] bằng uy lực，bằng võ lực
R:
pasayha：ပ-သယှ （အ-ကိတ်） （ ပ√သဟ်+ယ）
အနိုင်အထက်မူ၍။ နှိပ်စက်ညှဉ်းဆဲ၍။
DOP: 1 pasayha m. [ cf S. prasāha], force, violence; Abh 400 (~o balakkāro).

pasayhāvahāra.p: [ pasayha + avahāra] (pu) Google Translate Overpowering, oppressing, overpowering, threatening, stealing, taking unfairly.
